query:
INSERT INTO chat_members (
                chat_id,
                user_id,
                message_count,
                nickname_in_chat,
                joined_at,
                last_seen_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW(), NOW())
            ON CONFLICT (chat_id, user_id)
            DO UPDATE
            SET
                message_count = chat_members.message_count + 1,
                nickname_in_chat = EXCLUDED.nickname_in_chat,
                last_seen_at = NOW(),
                deleted_at = NULL
